rating_source: Blended Google + Facebook rating via Birdeye aggregator page (reviews.birdeye.com/addiction-tattoo-piercing-149484845906916), 4.8 stars across 303 total reviews. Birdeye explicitly breaks this down by source: Google 173 reviews + Facebook 130 reviews (Birdeye itself contributes 0 reviews of its own). Could not isolate a pure Google-only star average from the page; Birdeye only exposed the blended 4.8 figure plus individual review cards tagged as Facebook-sourced. Presented honestly here as a blended Google+Facebook figure (Google is the largest single source at 173 of 303 reviews), not claimed as a clean Google-only rating. Meets the pipeline's >=4.5 rating / >=10 reviews bar either way.

reviews_used_on_site.author: Amie Perdue
reviews_used_on_site.text: I would recommend them to anyone. The staff is always friendly and put out quality work. I've been a few times over the years and the owner and his wife are always professional and pleasant. Marc is amazingly talented with his Disney, anime, and comic book styles. Keith is very talented on a variety of styles as well.

reviews_used_on_site.author: Teri Elledge
reviews_used_on_site.text: I got my last two pieces done by John Schmitt and absolutely love them. Can't wait for my next which is in the works. This shop is The Shop. Always a great experience!!

reviews_used_on_site.author: Nadim Rocha
reviews_used_on_site.text: Keith is great. Does everything to make you comfortable even if the tat you choose is in a touchy spot and its your firat one. He did my daughters first one. Just completed one for me and have a few more planned

reviews_used_on_site.author: Morgan Kaisrlik
reviews_used_on_site.text: A friend and I went in to get piercings today and we absolutely loved it!! John was an amazing piercer, described ever thing to us, made sure we were happy with placement before he pierced, and had a blast doing it! ... It was truly a family environment and really fun.

reviews_available_not_used.author: Amanda DiAddezio
reviews_available_not_used.text: I got a beautiful Mandala tattoo on my forearm done by Tony. This was my fourth tattoo and my first big piece and I am so happy with the results! Tony drew the design freehand and it took about 3 1/2 hours to complete...

services_source: No published price list found anywhere (Instagram, Facebook, Birdeye, no owned booking platform). Services rendered as real categories/styles derived from research and review mentions (traditional, anime/comic/Disney, black & grey, color, cover-ups, body piercing), without any invented prices, following the precedent set by output/oddjobrob/data.json and index.html.

brand_vibe: Classic tattoo-shop aesthetic: dark base, ink-black interior feel. Palette chosen: deep crimson / blood red accent on a warm near-black base, a fresh palette not previously used per DESIGN.md's 'Paletas ya usadas' list (coral fairy, caramelo, esmeralda, teal acero, violeta dark, rosa dark, gold dark).
base_template: templates/dark-v2 (dark base, Pure Artistry exemplar, EN default)

palette.note: Merktop badge in footer intentionally kept gold (#D4A84B) per DESIGN.md rule, protected during the palette transform.

build_method: Anchored transformation script (Python, rep() with asserts + a few targeted regex full-block replaces for the services grid, gallery grid and reviews grid) over templates/dark-v2/index.html per templates/SKELETONS-V2.md. Palette pass used global hex/rgb-triplet substitution across the whole stylesheet (29 hex tokens + 6 rgb-only triplets), with the merktop-badge CSS block protected via a placeholder swap before and after the palette pass so it always stays gold.
